Messages.Author: Brian Iverson
Messages.Body:
TO ALL METHUSELAHS:

You are hereby invited to the upcoming tournament,

CRUSADE:ELKO

When: September 22 (VTES calendar shows the 15th but that will change)

Where: Elko, Nevada, at the Round Table Pizza in the Spring Creek
Plaza.

Time: Registration at 10:30am, first round starts at 11 am.

Format: Constructed deck with 3 rounds and 1 final round, two hours
each.

Cost: $2

Participants: expecting around 15 locals,.. out-of-towners? some we
hope!

Contact: Brian Iverson - Iverso...@citlink.net

This will be our first tournament using the new Camarilla edition
cards! What new decks will be the best? Or will the old tried and true
still reign supreme! Come join the fun!!

Brian Iverson
Prince of Elko

Messages.Author: Brian Iverson
Messages.Body:
Don't forget to come to the "one cow" town of Elko, Nevada and join us
for a fun filled day this coming Sunday. Rumor has it that a Las Vegas
Prince and a couple of his cohorts may be joining us! This is your
chance to try out the new CE cards in one of the first constructed
deck tournaments, now that the CE cards are legal.

Hope to see ya there!!

Brian Iverson
Prince of Elko
